learning_outcomes.text: Student can design a typical mechanical device

Student has basic knowledge on social, economical and environmental contexts of engineering activity, possesses basic knowledge on management, including quality management and running commercial enterprise, within the range of protection of intellectual property and patent law; knows general principles of creating and developing forms of individual entrepreneurship and basic HSE rules applicable to machine industry
Student has basic knowledge on methods of designing machine elements
Student is able to find relevant information from technical literature, databases, etc

assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a project (50%) and a lecture assessment (50%). A passing threshold of 100% is required for the project and 50% for the lecture assessment.
degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
